definitions.explanation: An instructor at a training institution: a driving school, the Self-Defense Forces, the police academy or a flight school. Formerly also a teacher at a national university, a use found in older texts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教習所|きょうしゅうじょ}→教習所：12929_kyoushuujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教官|きょうかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しかった→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The driving school instructor was strict.

examples.japanese: {教官|きょうかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訓練|くんれん}→訓練：02673_kunren⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{教官|きょうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧{隊員|たいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦{動作|どうさ}→動作：04074_dousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{叩|たた}き{込|こ}む→叩き込む：06052_tatakikomu⟧。
examples.english: In Self-Defense Forces training, instructors drill the basic movements into new recruits from scratch.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{教習所|きょうしゅうじょ}→教習所：12929_kyoushuujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教官|きょうかん}: driving school instructor
- ⟦{鬼|おに}→鬼：02184_oni⟧{教官|きょうかん}: a harsh, demanding instructor
- ⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧{教官|きょうかん}: flight instructor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指導員|しどういん}: instructor, coach — the official title at most driving schools today, though people still say {教官|きょうかん}
- ⟦{教員|きょういん}→教員：12942_kyouin⟧: teacher — a member of a school's teaching staff
- ⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: lecturer — gives classes or talks
